model_player_facing_excerpt: You carefully read the notice board pinned near Cinderwatch's gate. Among the listed new taxes and curfew rules, a warning catches your eye: the missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates. The message carries an air of urgency, hinting that the patrol's disappearance is causing concern among the gate authorities.

The notice board doesn’t specify the exact time when the patrol went missing. It only mentions that the last known sighting was as they took the northwest mud track past the crates. Beyond that, stories and fragments circulate among the threadbare watchers and refugees clustered near the gate, but no precise timing is recorded here. You might find more from those lingering around the muddy gate line or from the tavern runner trading rumors nearby.

"I haven't heard what the travelers have been saying," the gate guard admits with a guarded frown. "Most of what comes through is just chatter and rumors, and I can't vouch for their truth or relevance. You might do better asking those who linger around the gate line or the tavern runner haggling nearby."

"Most folks come to that board to catch up on the latest rules and warnings," the gate guard says with a slight shake of their head. "It lists taxes, curfews, and such, along with notices like that missing patrol. But beyond what's posted, I don't have any details on what else people might seek there."
